title: The First Brake: The Mitochondrial Gate

scenes.tts: A sympathetic neuron loses its N G F. What happens, step by step, before the killers switch on?
scenes.caption: A sympathetic neuron loses its NGF. What happens, step by step, before the killers switch on?
scenes.visual: Title card: The First Brake: The Mitochondrial Gate. A neuron with its axon in a target tissue.
scenes.narration: A sympathetic neuron loses its NGF. What happens, step by step, before the killers switch on?

scenes.tts: Keep the worm in mind. There, E G L one takes the brake off the killers.
scenes.caption: Keep the worm in mind. There, EGL-1 takes the brake off the killers.
scenes.visual: Small inset: worm pathway, EGL-1 lifting CED-9 off CED-4 and CED-3.
scenes.narration: Keep the worm in mind. There, EGL-1 takes the brake off the killers.

scenes.tts: The neuron's brake works one step earlier, as a gate at the mitochondria, which store cytochrome c.
scenes.visual: Inside the neuron: a mitochondrion holding cytochrome c, with a Bcl-2 guard at its surface.
scenes.narration: The neuron's brake works one step earlier, as a gate at the mitochondria, which store cytochrome c.

scenes.tts: Step one. The survival signal falls.
scenes.visual: Step 1 marker lights.
scenes.narration: Step one. The survival signal falls.

scenes.tts: N G F from the target acts through its receptor, track A, on the axon terminals.
scenes.caption: NGF from the target acts through its receptor, TrkA, on the axon terminals.
scenes.visual: NGF in the target binds TrkA on the axon terminals.
scenes.narration: NGF from the target acts through its receptor, TrkA, on the axon terminals.

scenes.tts: The signal keeps kinases such as Akt active. Akt holds back several pro-death proteins.
scenes.visual: Akt glows in the cell body, holding several pro-death proteins in check.
scenes.narration: The signal keeps kinases such as Akt active. Akt holds back several pro-death proteins.

scenes.tts: Without N G F, that restraint weakens.
scenes.caption: Without NGF, that restraint weakens.
scenes.visual: NGF disappears; Akt dims; the held proteins are freed.
scenes.narration: Without NGF, that restraint weakens.

scenes.tts: Step two. Pro-death genes are switched on.
scenes.visual: Step 2 marker lights.
scenes.narration: Step two. Pro-death genes are switched on.

scenes.tts: A stress pathway turns on. The kinase J N K becomes active.
scenes.caption: A stress pathway turns on. The kinase JNK becomes active.
scenes.visual: JNK lights up in the cytoplasm.
scenes.narration: A stress pathway turns on. The kinase JNK becomes active.

scenes.tts: J N K adds phosphates to a transcription factor called see-Jun.
scenes.caption: JNK adds phosphates to a transcription factor called c-Jun.
scenes.visual: In the nucleus, JNK adds phosphate tags to c-Jun, and c-Jun's target genes light up.
scenes.narration: JNK adds phosphates to a transcription factor called c-Jun.

scenes.tts: See-Jun rises in deprived neurons, and blocking its function protects them.
scenes.caption: c-Jun rises in deprived neurons, and blocking its function protects them.
scenes.visual: c-Jun level bar rises. Inset: c-Jun blocked, neuron survives.
scenes.narration: c-Jun rises in deprived neurons, and blocking its function protects them.

scenes.tts: Among the genes then induced are B H three only proteins, such as Bim.
scenes.caption: Among the genes then induced are BH3-only proteins, such as Bim.
scenes.visual: bim transcripts leave the nucleus; ribosomes in the cytoplasm make Bim protein.
scenes.narration: Among the genes then induced are BH3-only proteins, such as Bim.

scenes.tts: This is part of the new gene expression that the nineteen eighty-eight drugs blocked.
scenes.caption: This is part of the new gene expression that the 1988 drugs blocked.
scenes.visual: Callback: the delayed-death well from chapter 1. Label: what the 1988 drugs blocked.
scenes.narration: This is part of the new gene expression that the 1988 drugs blocked.

scenes.tts: Step three. The gate opens.
scenes.visual: Step 3 marker lights.
scenes.narration: Step three. The gate opens.

scenes.tts: A B H three domain is a short helix. It fits a groove on protective proteins, such as B C L two.
scenes.caption: A BH3 domain is a short helix. It fits a groove on protective proteins, such as Bcl-2.
scenes.visual: Bcl-xL structure (1BXL) with a BH3 helix lying in its groove.
scenes.narration: A BH3 domain is a short helix. It fits a groove on protective proteins, such as Bcl-2.

scenes.tts: That is what E G L one does to ced-nine in the worm.
scenes.caption: That is what EGL-1 does to CED-9 in the worm.
scenes.visual: Inset: EGL-1 in the CED-9 groove.
scenes.narration: That is what EGL-1 does to CED-9 in the worm.

scenes.tts: Protectors with filled grooves can no longer hold Bax back. Bim can also activate Bax directly.
scenes.visual: Bim fills Bcl-2's groove; Bax slips free. A second arrow: Bim touching Bax.
scenes.narration: Protectors with filled grooves can no longer hold Bax back. Bim can also activate Bax directly.

scenes.tts: Inactive Bax sits in the cytoplasm, with its last helix tucked into its own groove.
scenes.visual: Bax structure (1F16), its C-terminal helix tucked into its groove.
scenes.narration: Inactive Bax sits in the cytoplasm, with its last helix tucked into its own groove.

scenes.tts: Active Bax moves to the mitochondria. It inserts that helix into the outer membrane.
scenes.visual: Bax unfolds its helix and inserts it into the outer mitochondrial membrane.
scenes.narration: Active Bax moves to the mitochondria. It inserts that helix into the outer membrane.

scenes.tts: With other Bax molecules, it makes the membrane leaky. Cytochrome c escapes into the cytoplasm.
scenes.visual: Several Bax molecules in the outer membrane; cytochrome c streams out.
scenes.narration: With other Bax molecules, it makes the membrane leaky. Cytochrome c escapes into the cytoplasm.

scenes.tts: Step four. The killers assemble.
scenes.visual: Step 4 marker lights.
scenes.narration: Step four. The killers assemble.

scenes.tts: Cytochrome c binds Apaf one. Apaf one assembles into a wheel, called the apoptosome.
scenes.caption: Cytochrome c binds Apaf-1. Apaf-1 assembles into a wheel, called the apoptosome.
scenes.visual: Apoptosome wheel (3JBT) assembles from Apaf-1 units with cytochrome c near the rim.
scenes.narration: Cytochrome c binds Apaf-1. Apaf-1 assembles into a wheel, called the apoptosome.

scenes.tts: The apoptosome activates caspase nine. Caspase nine cuts and activates caspase three.
scenes.caption: The apoptosome activates caspase-9. Caspase-9 cuts and activates caspase-3.
scenes.visual: Caspase-9 lights at the hub, then cuts caspase-3, which lights up.
scenes.narration: The apoptosome activates caspase-9. Caspase-9 cuts and activates caspase-3.

scenes.tts: Caspase three takes the cell apart.
scenes.caption: Caspase-3 takes the cell apart.
scenes.visual: Caspase-3 cuts proteins; the neuron outline breaks up.
scenes.narration: Caspase-3 takes the cell apart.

scenes.tts: Now delete Bax, and take N G F away. Which steps still happen? Does the neuron live?
scenes.caption: Now delete Bax, and take NGF away. Which steps still happen? Does the neuron live?
scenes.visual: Question card held. The four step markers, Bax crossed out.
scenes.narration: Now delete Bax, and take NGF away. Which steps still happen? Does the neuron live?

scenes.tts: Steps one and two should still happen. They lie upstream of Bax.
scenes.visual: Steps 1 and 2 light: Akt dims, c-Jun and Bim rise.
scenes.narration: Steps one and two should still happen. They lie upstream of Bax.

scenes.tts: Step three cannot happen. The gate stays shut, and cytochrome c stays inside.
scenes.visual: Step 3 stays dark; cytochrome c held inside the mitochondrion.
scenes.narration: Step three cannot happen. The gate stays shut, and cytochrome c stays inside.

scenes.tts: The neuron survives. But it survives as a shrunken cell, because N G F also supports its growth.
scenes.caption: The neuron survives. But it survives as a shrunken cell, because NGF also supports its growth.
scenes.visual: The neuron lives but shrinks. Label: alive, but small.
scenes.narration: The neuron survives. But it survives as a shrunken cell, because NGF also supports its growth.

scenes.tts: That is the first brake. Brake one is the gate. N G F loss opens it through new gene expression.
scenes.visual: Guiding idea card: the first line, then 'Brake 1: the gate; NGF loss opens it through new gene expression.' End card line: brake one is the gate, opened through new gene expression.
scenes.narration: That is the first brake. Brake one is the gate. NGF loss opens it through new gene expression.
scenes.caption: That is the first brake. Brake one is the gate. NGF loss opens it through new gene expression.
